articles.title: We're Playing the Future of Badminton!
articles.description:
⚡ Big news, Cobras! 🐍

The BWF has officially confirmed that all international matches will switch to the new 15-point scoring system from 4th January 2027. We thought, why wait?

🎯 From 3rd June 2026, every Cobra Smash club night is being played under the new 3x15 format. That puts us a full seven months ahead of the international rollout. 🚀

🏸 You'll notice the games feel faster, the rallies feel sharper, and every single point carries a bit more weight. It's a brilliant way to sharpen up before the rest of the world catches on.

The future of badminton is already happening on our courts. Come and be part of it. 🔥

📎 Want the full details? Have a read of the BWF's official announcement here.

articles.title: Cobra Smash Election Results Are In!
articles.description:
🗳️ Thank you to everyone for voting, Cobras! 🐍

The votes have been cast, the results are in, and we're thrilled to announce the team who'll be steering the club forward. 🏆

🎉 Congratulations to your newly elected committee:

👥 Social Secretary: Adnan
🛡️ Cobra B Captain: Ram
⭐ Board Members: Raj & Kal — in a brilliant twist, both finished on equal votes, and we're excited to announce that both will be joining the board! 🤝
🏸 Cobra A Captain: Rav (continuing in the role)

A huge thank you to everyone who stood for election, voted, and got involved. This is your club, and your voice shapes its future. 🔥

Here's to a brilliant season ahead — let's take the club forward together! 🚀

⭐ Thanks everyone for the support! ⭐

articles.title: Rav, Men's Doubles Champion Again! 🏆
articles.description:
🎉 Huge congratulations to Rav for winning the Men's Doubles Badminton Championship at the Zahira Summer Festival 2025 on Sunday, 29th June 2025 at Harrow, London! 🇬🇧

After a fierce contest, with both teams winning one game each, Rav and his partner sealed the victory in a thrilling final game with a close score of 22-20! 🏸🔥

Another proud moment for the Cobra Smash team this season! 🐍🥇

articles.title: Sri & Rav, Men's Doubles Champions! 🏆
articles.description: 🎉 Huge congratulations to Sri & Rav for clinching the Men's Doubles Champion title at the Gemstars Summer Smash 2025! A spectacular performance in the final. Being 1 game down and Rav on 1 leg, they both produced a brilliant display to come out champions!!! 🥇🔥
